questions.question: Select the correct active form of the given sentence. Her phone can’t be switched off by my father.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

Her phone can’t be switched off by my father.

options.html: My father can’t switch off her phone.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: My father can’t switch off her phone.

Key Points 

  • The given sentence is in the passive form and we need to change it into the active form.
  • ​Both the sentence use a modal verb 'can'. The structures for active/passive voices for modal verbs are:
    • ​Passive: Object + Modal verb + be + Verb (IIIrd form) + by + Subject
    • Active: Subject + Modal verb + Verb (Ist form) + Object
  • Example - 
    • Active voice - We can buy diamonds, but we cannot buy sympathy.
    • Passive voice - Diamonds can be bought but sympathy cannot be bought.
  • Rules of Conversion from Passive to Active Voice:
    • Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
    • Change the object into the subject.
    • Change the verb into the past participle form of the verb.
    • Change the subject into an object.
  • ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.
     

Correct Active Voice: My father can’t switch off her phone.

Key Points  

  • In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
  • In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
  • The given sentence is in the passive voice and when we convert this sentence into active voice, the passive format "be + V3 (told)" should be converted into the active format "V1 (tell)".
  • This is the active and passive voice rule for the present simple tense.
     

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Additional Information

  • Verbs of passive format have a different set of tenses (*V3 - Past participle or Third form of the Verb) as given below in the table:
     
    TENSE ACTIVE PASSIVE PASSIVE CONVERSION
    Present Simple He plays football am/is/are + V3 Football is played by him
    Present Continuous He is/am/are playing football am/is/are + being +V3 Football is being played by him
    Present Perfect He has played football Has/have + been+ V3 Football has been played by him
    Present Perfect Continuous He has been playing football Not used and unusual. Not used and unusual
    Past Simple He played football Was/were + V3 Football was played by him
    Past Continuous He was playing football Was/were + being + V3 Football was being played by him
    Past Perfect He had played football Had + been + V3 Football had been played by him
    Past Perfect Continuous He had been playing football Not used and unusual Not used and unusual
    Future Simple He will play football Will + be + V3 Football will be played by him
    Future Continuous He will be playing football Not used and unusual Not used and unusual
    Future Perfect He will have played football Will have been + V3 Football will have been played by him
    Future Perfect Continuous He will have been playing football Not used and unusual Not used and unusual

  • The rule for changing a Present Continuous Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
    • Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
    • Structure: 
      • Subject + is/am/are + v1 + ing + object (Active Voice)
      • Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by Subject (Passive Voice) 
    • Example: 
      • Esha is singing a song. (Active Voice)
      • A song is being sung by Esha. (Passive Voice)
        ​

Correct Answer: She is writing an anthology of poems on childhood.

Additional Information    

  • In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
  • In Passive Voice, the sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
    • Example: He reads a novel. (Active Voice)
                       A novel is read by him. (Passive Voice)​

Hinglish   

  • दिया गया वाक्य Present Continuous Tense और Passive Voice में है।
  • Present Continuous Tense को Active voice से Passive voice या Passive voice से Active voice में बदलने का नियम:
    • Object और Subject को एक दूसरे के साथ बदलें, यानी Active Voice का object, Passive Voice का subject बन जाती है।
    • Structure: 
      • Subject + is/am/are + v1 + ing + object (Active Voice)
      • Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by Subject (Passive Voice) 
    • Example: 
      • Esha is singing a song. (Active Voice)
      • A song is being sung by Esha. (Passive Voice)

questions.solution: The Passive voice in this question is in Past Indefinite. Thus, the Active voice will also be in Past Indefinite. In Passive voice, the format is: Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + was/were + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case). Thus, the format of Active voice is: Subject + V2 + Object.
